fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant left a maroon scooter bearing registration number TN-39-YY-1049 near Vaigai Park Parking Area and could not find it later. The matter was brought to Chennai South PS on 2026-04-30, while the incident was placed on 2026-04-27 at about 01:00. The complainant, Nandhini Selvi, provided the contact number 9000000239. The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. A witness, Madhan Kumar, reachable on 9000000410, was mentioned in the complaint. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly taken after the handle lock was forced.
fields.Keywords: scooter theft, vehicle, witness statement, witness, scooter, night, parking area
